title: 提示点/标记
description: 用于在元素角标位置显示提示点或数字标记的组件，双端可用。

props.name: size
props.description: 角标尺寸，两端档位不同（web 为 px、uniapp 为 rpx 标尺）。

props.name: text
props.description: 角标文本内容；不传（或空）时仅显示纯色小圆点。

props.name: show
props.description: 是否显示角标，可配合 `v-model:show` 使用。

props.name: inset
props.description: 是否内嵌贴合宿主边缘（默认角标中心压在宿主角上）。

props.name: standalone
props.description: 是否作为独立角标渲染（无宿主内容时使用）。

props.name: customClass
props.description: **仅 UniApp**。追加到根元素的自定义类名。

props.name: class
props.description: 追加到根元素的自定义类名

props.name: ui
props.description: 按内部结构键（root/base/label）覆盖对应节点的样式类

events.name: update:show
events.description: 显隐状态变化时触发，配合 `v-model:show` 同步

slots.name: default
slots.description: 宿主内容，作为角标的定位锚点；`standalone` 场景下可为空。

examples.title: Web 演示
UniApp 演示
examples.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import RebornCard from '@/components/reborn-card/RebornCard.vue'
import { chipColors, chipPositions, chipSizes } from '@/components/reborn-chip/reborn-chip.config'
import RebornChip from '@/components/reborn-chip/RebornChip.vue'
import RebornInput from '@/components/reborn-input/RebornInput.vue'

import RebornPage from '@/components/reborn-page/RebornPage.vue'

const showChip = ref(true)
const currentColor = ref<typeof chipColors[number]>('primary')
const currentSize = ref<typeof chipSizes[number]>('md')
const currentPosition = ref<typeof chipPositions[number]>('top-right')
const chipText = ref('100+')
</script>

<template>
  <RebornPage title="Chip" description="Chip component for counters and indicators.">
    <RebornCard title="Controls" custom-class="space-y-4">
      <view class="space-y-3">
        <view
          class="
            text-sm font-medium text-slate-500
            dark:text-slate-200
          "
        >
          Color
        </view>
        <view class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <view
            v-for="c in chipColors" :key="c"
            class="
              size-6 cursor-pointer rounded-full ring-2 ring-transparent
              ring-offset-2 transition-all
            "
            :class="[`
              bg-${c}
            `, currentColor === c ? 'scale-110 ring-slate-400' : `
              hover:scale-110
            `]"
            :style="{ backgroundColor: `var(--color-${c}, ${c === 'neutral' ? '#737373' : ''})` }"
            @click="currentColor = c"
          />
        </view>
      </view>

      <view class="space-y-3">
        <view
          class="
            text-sm font-medium text-slate-500
            dark:text-slate-200
          "
        >
          Size
        </view>
        <view class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <view
            v-for="s in chipSizes" :key="s"
            class="
              cursor-pointer rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs
              transition-colors
            "
            :class="currentSize === s ? `
              border-slate-900 bg-slate-900 text-white
              dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900
            ` : `
              border-slate-300 bg-transparent text-slate-600
              hover:border-slate-400
            `"
            @click="currentSize = s"
          >
            {{ s }}
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>

      <view class="space-y-3">
        <view
          class="
            text-sm font-medium text-slate-500
            dark:text-slate-200
          "
        >
          Position
        </view>
        <view class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <view
            v-for="p in chipPositions" :key="p"
            class="
              cursor-pointer rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs
              transition-colors
            "
            :class="currentPosition === p ? `
              border-slate-900 bg-slate-900 text-white
              dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900
            ` : `
              border-slate-300 bg-transparent text-slate-600
              hover:border-slate-400
            `"
            @click="currentPosition = p"
          >
            {{ p }}
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>

      <view class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <view class="text-sm text-slate-500">
          Text:
        </view>
        <RebornInput v-model="chipText" :rounded="false" />
        <view class="ml-auto">
          <view class="rounded border px-3 py-1 text-sm" @tap="showChip = !showChip">
            {{ showChip ? 'Hide' : 'Show' }}
          </view>
        </view>
      </view>
    </RebornCard>
    <RebornCard title="Preview" custom-class="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
      <RebornChip
        v-model:show="showChip" :color="currentColor" :size="currentSize" :position="currentPosition"
        :text="chipText"
      >
        <view
          class="
            flex size-16 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-slate-100
            dark:bg-slate-800
          "
        >
          <text
            class="
              text-xs text-slate-500
              dark:text-slate-200
            "
          >
            Target
          </text>
        </view>
      </RebornChip>
      <RebornChip
        v-model:show="showChip" :color="currentColor" :size="currentSize" :position="currentPosition"
        :text="chipText" inset
      >
        <image
          src="https://github.com/benjamincanac.png" class="
            size-12 rounded-full
          "
        />
      </RebornChip>
    </RebornCard>
  </RebornPage>
</template>

whenToUse: 图标、头像或按钮右上角显示未读数量（text 传数字或文本）。
仅需红点提醒而无文字的消息提示（不传 text 即为小圆点）。
需要通过 v-model:show 动态控制标记显隐的场景。
whenNotToUse: 独立展示状态文字标签（非角标叠加），改用 reborn-badge。
pitfalls: web 与 uniapp 双端可用。
默认以默认插槽内容为锚点定位（position 默认 top-right），无宿主独立使用时需设 standalone。
inset 使标记内嵌于宿主边缘，与 position 组合调整贴合位置。
